business_summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG provides dialysis and related services for individuals with renal diseases in Germany, the United States, and internationally. The company offers dialysis treatment and related laboratory and diagnostic services through a network of outpatient dialysis clinics; materials, training, and patient support services comprising clinical monitoring, follow-up assistance, and arranging for delivery of the supplies to the patient's residence; and dialysis services under contract to hospitals in the United States for the hospitalized end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients and for patients suffering from acute kidney failure. The company operates through Care Delivery and Care Enablement segments. It also develops, manufactures, and distributes various health care products, including hemodialysis machines, peritoneal dialysis cyclers, peritoneal dialysis solutions, hemodialysis concentrates, solutions and granulates, bloodlines, renal pharmaceuticals, systems for water treatment, and acute cardiopulmonary and apheresis products. In addition, the company develops, acquires, and in-licenses renal pharmaceuticals; offers renal medications and supplies to patients at homes or to dialysis clinics; and provides vascular specialty, ambulatory surgery center, physician nephrology practice management, pharmacy and other services. The company sells its products to dialysis clinics, hospitals, and specialized treatment clinics, as well as through local sales forces, independent distributors, dealers, and sales agents. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Bad Homburg, Germany.
business_summary_ko: Fresenius Medical Care AG는 독일, 미국 및 국제적으로 신장 질환이 있는 개인에게 투석 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 외래 투석 클리닉 네트워크를 통해 투석 치료와 관련 실험실 및 진단 서비스를 제공합니다. 임상 모니터링, 후속 지원, 환자 거주지로 물품 배송 준비 등으로 구성된 자료, 교육 및 환자 지원 서비스 입원한 말기 신장 질환(ESRD) 환자와 급성 신부전으로 고통받는 환자를 위해 미국 병원과 계약을 맺은 투석 서비스. 이 회사는 Care Delivery 및 Care Enablement 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 또한 혈액투석기, 복막투석 순환기, 복막투석액, 혈액투석 농축액, 용액 및 과립제, 혈통, 신장 의약품, 수처리 시스템, 급성 심폐 및 성분채집 제품을 포함한 다양한 건강 관리 제품을 개발, 제조 및 유통합니다. 또한 회사는 신장 의약품을 개발, 인수 및 라이선스하고 있습니다. 집에서 환자에게 신장 약물과 용품을 제공합니다.
